limitations: Root positions are serialized prefab values, not authenticated runtime placements.
All component fields/bytes are retained, including renderer shadow/lightmap metadata and collider flags; MonoBehaviour execution and skinned animation conversion remain separate work.
Material and source 2D texture mip assets are decoded; non-2D samplers retain full fields/bytes and explicit unsupported status. Shader execution and original runtime appearance remain unverified.
Unresolved built-in references remain explicit; decoded mesh/material dependencies are required.
Bundle-cache statistics bound cache-owned payloads, excluding caller-held handles and parsed object metadata.
